affected.note: Totals as of the 2024-02-14 update, including estimated and possible leaks: 302,980 user records (130,192 in Japan), 86,211 business partner records and 130,315 employee and staff records. The first notice of 2023-11-27 gave about 440,000. User data was service usage history linked to internal LINE identifiers; LINE chat content, bank and card data were not included.

summary.en: LY Corporation said a third party used a malware-infected PC of a subcontractor shared with Korea's NAVER Cloud to reach LINE's systems through a shared authentication platform, starting in September 2023. Data of users, business partners and employees leaked, totalling 519,506 records after later updates.
summary.ja: LINEヤフーは、韓国NAVER Cloudと共通の委託先の従業員PCがマルウェアに感染し、共通の認証基盤を経由して2023年9月以降にLINEのシステムへ不正アクセスされたと公表した。利用者、取引先、従業員などの情報が漏えいし、その後の更新で合計519,506件となった。
